data.content_ref: inline:Generalize the existing closure rule — any attacker of `validity_node` attacks the warrant — into a systematic family: every structural node (validity, internal consistency, coherence) generates an attack edge to its carrier's warrant, and the closure is computed to a fixed point before the grounded extension runs. The closure is a pure function of the graph (deterministic) with bounded fan-out (polynomial), so the fixpoint guarantees survive; this strengthens completeness of the attack graph so that no structural flaw can slip through as a silent suspension.
